bayesian_learning.categorical_model.parameter_learning.shrinkage.learn_shrinkage_parameters(location: str, bn: Any) → BayesNet¶

Shrinkage estimator for parameter learning.

Applies the shrinkage estimator on an already defined structure and a dataset to learn the bayesian network’s CPTS

Parameters:

  • location – The path of the dataset (csv).

  • bn – A bayesian network with an already defined structure.

Returns:

The bayesian network with updated CPTS.
